FAQs.q: What areas does Osborne Electric serve?
FAQs.a: We serve Salt Lake County, Utah County, Davis County, Tooele County, and Summit County. This includes cities like Salt Lake City , Sandy , Draper , Provo , Orem , Lehi , Bountiful , Layton , and Park City .

FAQs.q: Is Osborne Electric licensed and insured?
FAQs.a: Yes. Osborne Electric & Contracting is fully licensed by the State of Utah. The company holds Utah DOPL contractor license #12644476-5501, and all electrical work is qualified by Master Electrician Wes Osborne (Utah licence #8528070-5502). We carry comprehensive liability insurance for your protection.

FAQs.q: What electrical services do you provide?
FAQs.a: We specialize in both commercial and residential electrical services. Commercial services include tenant improvements , industrial & warehouse electrical , and data & low voltage systems . Residential services include panel upgrades , lighting installation , power restoration and emergency repairs , remodels and new construction wiring , and full home electrical services including outlet repairs, switch installation, rewiring, and home safety inspections.

FAQs.q: Does Osborne Electric do commercial work?
FAQs.a: Yes! We handle a full range of commercial electrical projects including office buildouts, retail renovations, restaurant wiring, tenant improvements, and commercial lighting upgrades. Our contractor license and bonding enable us to work on commercial properties throughout Utah.

FAQs.q: What types of commercial projects do you handle?
FAQs.a: We handle commercial tenant improvements, office buildouts, retail spaces, restaurant electrical systems, industrial facilities , warehouse power distribution, structured cabling and data centers , security system wiring, and commercial lighting retrofits. From small office spaces to large industrial facilities, we scale to your project needs.

FAQs.q: Do you work with commercial contractors and property managers?
FAQs.a: Absolutely. We regularly partner with general contractors, property management companies, and commercial developers. We understand project timelines, permit requirements, and code compliance for commercial work. Our team can coordinate with other trades and deliver projects on time and within budget.
Yes. We provide free estimates for both commercial and residential electrical projects across our 5-county service area. Call 801-885-4521 or submit a request through our contact form .

FAQs.q: How do I schedule electrical work?
FAQs.a: Call 801-885-4521 , email Osborne-electric@outlook.com , or fill out the contact form on our website. We respond promptly and can typically schedule an assessment within a few days.

FAQs.q: What makes Osborne Electric different from other electricians?
FAQs.a: Osborne Electric is family-owned by Trevor Osborne, who personally oversees every project. Unlike large companies that send subcontractors, our own team handles every job with A+ workmanship, honest pricing, and personal accountability.
